question_en:

- item 
- Property applying to item 
- Property value (another item)

- Movie, director credit, Stanley Kubrick 
- Movie, is movie, 1
- Movie, year released, 1968
What is the result?

- propriété appliquée à l’élément

- Film, est un film, 1
